mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS totalExpense, COUNT(*) AS transactionCount FROM TRANSACTIONS WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = 'EXPENSE' AND category NOT IN ('INCOME', 'SEND', 'CARD_WITHDRAWAL') AND transaction_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT category AS category, SUM(amount) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS transactionCount FROM TRANSACTIONS WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = 'EXPENSE' AND category NOT IN ('INCOME', 'SEND', 'CARD_WITHDRAWAL') AND transaction_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY category ORDER BY category ASC

SELECT CASE DAYOFWEEK(transaction_date) WHEN 1 THEN 'SUNDAY' WHEN 2 THEN 'MONDAY' WHEN 3 THEN 'TUESDAY' WHEN 4 THEN 'WEDNESDAY' WHEN 5 THEN 'THURSDAY' WHEN 6 THEN 'FRIDAY' WHEN 7 THEN 'SATURDAY' END AS weekday, SUM(amount) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS transactionCount FROM TRANSACTIONS WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = 'EXPENSE' AND category NOT IN ('INCOME', 'SEND', 'CARD_WITHDRAWAL') AND transaction_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DAYOFWEEK(transaction_date) ORDER BY CASE DAYOFWEEK(transaction_date) WHEN 2 THEN 1 WHEN 3 THEN 2 WHEN 4 THEN 3 WHEN 5 THEN 4 WHEN 6 THEN 5 WHEN 7 THEN 6 WHEN 1 THEN 7 END
